title: Pure Ancient Gear
summary: Ancient Gear cards with generic staples. Ancient Gear Wyvern searches any Ancient Gear card when summoned, and Ancient Gear Fusion uses monsters from the Deck as material once Ancient Gear Golem is on the field, so one Golem turns into Chaos Ancient Gear Giant, which attacks every monster and shuts off their effects in battle. The 2024-25 cards lead. Ancient Gear Statue, the newest card, summons itself when the opponent has more monsters and tributes itself to summon Ancient Gear Golem or a card that mentions it from the hand or Deck. Ancient Gear Dark Golem counts as Golem and searches two cards. Ancient Gear Commander and Ancient Gear Advance grant extra Normal Summons, and Ancient Gear Dragon negates Spells and Traps. Most Ancient Gears stop the opponent from responding when they attack.
main: Ancient Gear Wyvern
Starter: searches any Ancient Gear card when summoned; stops monster effects in its battles.
Ancient Gear Statue
Newest: summons itself, then tributes itself to summon a Golem from the hand or Deck.
Ancient Gear Dark Golem
Counts as Ancient Gear Golem; searches two Ancient Gear cards when summoned.
Ancient Gear Commander
Sends a Golem for an extra Ancient Gear Normal Summon; revives Golems.
Ancient Gear Golem
The Level 8 every Fusion and Golem effect names.
Ancient Gear Tanker
Summons an Ancient Gear from the hand or GY; pumps the Golems.
Ancient Gear Frame
Discards to search Ancient Gear Golem or a Spell/Trap that names it.
Ancient Gear Dragon
Normal Summons without tributing; negates a Spell/Trap by sending a Machine or Golem.
Geartown
Field Spell: cheaper Tribute Summons; summons an Ancient Gear when destroyed.
Ancient Gear Advance
Searches an Ancient Gear Spell/Trap; tributes for a draw and a free Golem Normal Summon.
Ancient Gear Fusion
Fusion Summons with Deck materials once a Golem is out.
Ancient Gear Catapult
On an empty field, destroys your card to summon an Ancient Gear from the Deck.
Ancient Gear Duel
Golems unaffected by their monster effects; Fusion Summons by banishing.
